title: A seed-specific DNA-binding with One Finger transcription factor, RPBF, positively regulates galactinol synthase to maintain seed vigour in rice.
authors: Sonowal, Kaberi; Gandass, Nishu; Kamble, Nitin Uttam; Mehta, Kritika; Pandey, Ajay Kumar; Salvi, Prafull
one_liner_zh: 该文研究水稻DOF转录因子RPBF通过调控半乳糖醇合酶基因表达影响种子活力，虽涉及TF-DNA结合（酵母单杂交、分子对接），但核心为湿实验验证，AI/物理模拟方法仅浅层应用，属广义TF-DNA调控研究。
abstract: Seed vigour and longevity are intricate yet indispensable physiological traits for agricultural crops, as they play a crucial role in facilitating the successful emergence of seedlings and exert a substantial influence on crop productivity. Transcriptional regulation plays an important role in seed development, maturation, and desiccation tolerance, which are important attributes for seed vigour and longevity. Here, we have investigated the regulatory role of the seed-specific DNA-binding with One Finger (DOF) transcription factor and the rice prolamin box binding factor (RPBF) in seed vigour. RPBF modulates the transcription of galactinol synthase (GolS) and improves seed vigour. The promoter region of GolS-encoding genes from different species was enriched with DOF-binding sites, and the expression levels of both RPBF; OsGolS were found to enhance during seed development. Furthermore, direct interaction of RPBF with the OsGolS promoter has been demonstrated through multiple approaches: yeast one-hybrid assays, in planta promoter-GUS assays, dual luciferase assay, and in silico molecular docking. To assess functionality, Agrobacterium-mediated genetic transformation of rice was performed to generate the RNAi lines with reduced RPBF expression. In these RNAi lines, a reduction in both galactinol and raffinose content was observed. Since galactinol and raffinose are known contributors to seed vigour, the T2-transgenic lines were assessed for vigour and viability. For this, RNAi seeds were subjected to accelerated ageing by exposing them to high relative humidity and temperature, followed by scoring the germination and viability potential. Tetrazolium and seed germination assay revealed that the RNAi seeds were more sensitive to ageing compared to their wild-type and vector control counterparts. Collectively, this is the first report demonstrating that the DOF transcription factor RPBF controls the seed vigour through transcriptional regulation of GolS.
abstract_zh: 种子活力和寿命是农作物复杂而不可或缺的生理性状，因为它们在促进幼苗成功出土中起着关键作用，并对作物生产力产生重大影响。转录调控在种子发育、成熟和耐脱水性中发挥重要作用，这些是种子活力和寿命的重要属性。在此，我们研究了种子特异性DNA结合单指（DOF）转录因子和水稻醇溶蛋白盒结合因子（RPBF）在种子活力中的调控作用。RPBF调节半乳糖醇合酶（GolS）的转录并提高种子活力。来自不同物种的GolS编码基因的启动子区域富含DOF结合位点，并且RPBF和OsGolS的表达水平在种子发育过程中均被发现增强。此外，通过多种方法证明了RPBF与OsGolS启动子的直接相互作用：酵母单杂交实验、植物体内启动子-GUS实验、双荧光素酶实验和计算机分子对接。为评估功能，通过农杆菌介导的遗传转化生成了RPBF表达降低的RNAi水稻株系。在这些RNAi株系中，观察到半乳糖醇和棉子糖含量均有所降低。由于半乳糖醇和棉子糖已知是种子活力的贡献因素，因此对T2转基因株系进行了活力和生存力评估。为此，将RNAi种子暴露于高相对湿度和温度下进行加速老化，随后评估其萌发和生存力潜力。四唑和种子萌发实验表明，与野生型和载体对照相比，RNAi种子对老化更为敏感。综合来看，这是首次报道证明DOF转录因子RPBF通过GolS的转录调控控制种子活力。
